outcome: The engine's own journals answer the questions the operator today answers with provider consoles and hand probes: every dispatch on a certified surface lands a usage receipt with the full token split the wire actually carried - input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning - plus wall-clock duration, and an attempt that genuinely cannot report says so loudly with the surface named instead of defaulting silent. The eval summary stops rendering a partial sum as a total: coverage rides in-band with every aggregate, and turn economics - turns, tool calls, call mix per role - become first-class eval facts.

exclude: OTel span and metric vocabulary (S2's mechanism; this slice makes the facts true in receipts and eval records, S2 exports them)
journal schema (the usage receipt and eval record bodies are opaque JSON blobs; no table change)
provider request behavior (no adapter changes what it sends; this slice only captures what comes back)

waivers.reason: its tests reach internal/driver, internal/observe, and internal/runtime by import only; no cmd test pins usage-receipt or eval-record content, and the CLI surface is untouched by this slice
its tests reach internal/driver and internal/runtime by import only; no cockpit test pins token capture or eval aggregation, and presentation is untouched by this slice
its tests reach internal/driver (via internal/cockpit) and internal/runtime by import only; no tui test pins usage or eval content

acceptance.text: On every certified provider surface whose wire response carries usage, the attempt's usage receipt reports token_status=reported with the full split the wire offered - input, output, and the cache-read, cache-write, and reasoning components when present (driver.Usage, internal/driver/contract.go:146; NormalizeUsage, internal/driver/usage.go:43). Pinned by per-adapter response-mapping tests over recorded wire shapes for each certified adapter family (responses, openai chat, gemini native, claude and codex native). The sharpest instance is pinned by name: the responses usage parser never extracts reasoning tokens (internal/driver/responses.go:298-337) while the live renderer reads and prints that very field from the same payloads (internal/driver/stream.go:159-164) - reasoning counts scroll past on stderr and die there; gemini is the only adapter whose reasoning tokens reach the journal today. A wire body that names a number and a receipt that drops it is a failing test.

An attempt whose usage receipt reports token_status=unavailable is loud, never a silent default: the receipt names the reporting surface (adapter id) and a stable reason, distinguishing wire-lacked-usage from capture-failed (today's silent paths: the blanket default at internal/driver/invoke.go:329 and the hardcoded all-unavailable fallback literal at internal/runtime/dispatch.go:2068). Pinned by tests that an unavailable receipt always carries surface and reason.

The eval summary cannot render a partial sum as a total: token, cost, and cache aggregates carry their coverage in-band wherever the totals go (the mechanism at internal/observe/eval.go:538-547 sums only reporting attempts while coverage lives in a separate ratio), and a summary over mixed coverage names the non-reporting surfaces. Pinned by observe tests: an aggregate over 10 attempts of which 3 reported renders as a coverage-qualified figure naming what is missing, never as a bare number.

Per-attempt wall-clock duration, provider-reported cost, and the dispatched model identity reach the durable eval path: the observation's duration (driver.Observation.DurationMillis, internal/driver/invoke.go:124), any wire-reported cost distinguished from nominal computed cost, and the profile and certified model id actually dispatched all land in the eval record. Pinned by eval fixture tests; the eval record schema version reflects the new fields honestly.

Turn economics are first-class eval facts: turns per dispatch, tool calls per turn, and tool-call mix, attributable per role, land in eval records and the existing metric projection. Pinned by observe tests over a fixture dispatch history.

constraints: This is sworn#209 plus the day-1 telemetry ruling: eval capture is the data moat and cannot be backfilled - live runs were journaling input_tokens: null while the driver demonstrably held the numbers, and the 2026-08-17 Gemini TPM diagnosis had to come from the provider console instead of our own journals.
Absence stays honest: pointer fields mean not-reported, never measured-zero (the driver.Usage invariant). This slice widens what is captured; it never invents a number the wire did not carry.

The usage receipt schema (sworn.usage receipt, internal/driver/usage.go) and eval record schema (sworn.eval, internal/observe/eval.go:20) may add fields and bump versions; existing journaled histories must still decode - the evaluator reads old journals.
No journal table changes: usage receipts and eval record bodies are opaque blobs by design (internal/journal/schema.sql attempts.usage, eval_records.body).
Check evidence belongs in the submission's checks field, never in files added to the repository.

Revision 2 scope boundary: internal/journal enters this slice's edit surface solely for the eval schema-version allowlist at internal/journal/observer.go (EvalSchemaVersionV1/V2 must admit the bumped sworn.eval version this slice's A4 requires, so the bumped records stay readable by the observer); no other journal surface is edited and the no-table-change constraint above is unchanged.

Revision 3 scope boundary: test/e2e enters this slice's edit surface solely for the eval schema-version conformance assertions - test/e2e/turn_recovery_linux_test.go:711 and :1642 pin journal.EvalSchemaVersionV2 on records that internal/observe/eval.go:514 stamps live, so they follow the bumped sworn.eval version A4 requires (the same minimal shape revision 2 used for internal/journal). No other e2e assertion is weakened or edited, and the e2e gate remains CI-executed, declared not executed, per ADR-0010.
